svg.title: Real-Time Streaming Pipeline — Kafka + PySpark project card
svg.desc: Streaming architecture from Azure Event Hubs through Kafka broker to PySpark Structured Streaming, with Delta Lake sinks to both Snowflake and ADLS Gen2, orchestrated by Apache Airflow in Docker.
